surfaces.surface_type: floating search palette / menu-bar command results panel
failures: #9 selection text ~3.5-3.7:1 (white on systemBlue #0088FF) borderline vs AA 4.5:1 for 13-14pt body
#3 (rubric) full-width hairline under every row flattens within- vs between-group proximity; only section whitespace signals grouping
native #3 selection is full-bleed saturated bar with white text, not the current inset-rounded accent-tinted fill

tokens.notes: exact match to macOS-27 kit System Blue (Light); system accent correctly bound to selection + all icon glyphs
softened off-white for results + search header, not pure #FFF

tokens.value: full-bleed saturated fill, white label/glyph, translucent-white count pill
tokens.notes: no inset, no rounded corners; legacy NSTableView selection idiom
Apple's own selection combo; below AA 4.5:1 for normal text
3 node glyphs (menu window-outline / command menu-item / script {}) all one accent hue
search-field text/placeholder, larger than list body; retina scale of composite indeterminate
row labels; snaps to 13pt macOS Body; scale caveat applies
'Menu Items'/'Scripts' — native title-case header, not tracked uppercase

tokens.value: ~11pt dark number in gray capsule pill ~#E3E3E3

tokens.notes: comfortable native list row; relative-to-header ratio is the reliable read

tokens.value: borderless; leading slot holds target app icon (Finder), not a magnifier glyph

patterns.key_values: borderless search header (~48-52pt) + hairline divider + opaque results list; no traffic lights; NSPanel-style launcher
single-column outline; ~28pt rows; disclosure chevron + accent glyph + label + capsule count pill; full-width per-row hairlines; depth by icon indent
renders a target app's full menu bar as a searchable, quantified tree (top-level menus -> commands -> sub-menus), plus a Scripts section
count-badge-on-every-branch = information-scent device unique to this app vs Spotlight/Alfred flat match lists

signature_moves: Quantified menu tree: a live count pill on every branch ('File 38', 'Edit 16', 'Services... 24') turns the menu bar into a browsable, sized outline and surfaces depth before you open a node
App-icon-as-search-context: the search field's leading slot shows the target app's icon (Finder) instead of a magnifier glyph, answering 'whose menus am I searching?'
Single-hue monochrome iconography: three node glyphs (menu / command / script {}) all in system accent #0088FF, so the icon column reads as structure not decoration
defects: Full-bleed selection idiom (native-tell, defensible) - saturated edge-to-edge bar with white text instead of the current inset-rounded accent-tinted fill; systematic + purposeful for a keyboard palette so recorded as category convention, but the clearest divergence from macOS 26+ grammar

Contrast Dilution (adjacent) - a hairline under every row (not just sections) adds grid noise and flattens the proximity ladder; source-list grouping by whitespace would let labels + badges carry structure
Selection text contrast borderline - white on systemBlue ~3.5-3.7:1, under AA 4.5:1 for body-size text (a semibold selected-row weight would help)

aesthetic.direction: Neo-grotesque product / native-utilitarian - HIG-default utility carried by one saturated system accent rather than a committed bespoke look; competent-but-anonymous chrome with a strong functional idea

psychology: Information scent (Pirolli & Card) - count badge on every branch predicts how much lives behind a node before opening it; the app's core UX bet
Jakob's Law - search-at-top + keyboard list nav mirror Spotlight/Alfred, so the interaction is pre-learned; near-zero onboarding cost
Von Restorff effect - single saturated selection row is unmistakably the 'Enter fires this' target
Recognition over recall - shows the actual menu labels rather than requiring users to remember which menu a command lives under (the product thesis)
Fitts's Law - full-width rows are large hit targets, though the surface is keyboard-first
notes: ONLY evidence is the app window embedded in a marketing cover composite (1200x630), cropped at the right edge - no dedicated screenshots in sources (gallery empty). Retina scale of the embedded window is indeterminate, so all pt sizes are estimated and could be off by ~2x; relative density and the scale-independent, pixel-confirmed accent #0088FF are the trustworthy reads. No glass evidence (flat opaque panel) -> era marked 'custom'/insufficient-evidence for material, not asserted as big-sur or liquid-glass. Icon (context only, not digested under Workflow A): squircle window/menu-list half-submerged in blue water with a teal shark fin cutting through it - a 'fin + (menu) bar' visual pun with glossy/glass sheen; brand wordmark is a heavy black grotesque on white. Single surface, single app -> no canon promotion; contributes to a possible native-utility-launcher cluster and to floating-panel/list/menu-bar-extra pattern entries.
